notes.title: Update version 1.6.7
notes.notes:
Version 1.6.7

While reviewing everything after the last update, I came across a few things I wanted to refine, so I'm releasing another version so soon.


 Optimized the fear of mannequins in the first intermediate level, as loading the models caused extremely low FPS on some PCs. This should no longer be noticeable.
 Changed the post-processing effect for the appearance of some fears to be visually better and not overwhelm the image with excessive brightness.
 Tweaked, optimized, and improved the lighting of the first intermediate level.
 Prepared systems for possible future DLCs (currently only testing).

notes.title: Update Version 1.6.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.6.6


 Fixed an issue where the selected fear in the initial questionnaire was sometimes not saved, resulting in the default monster fear always being displayed and the cutscenes and enemies not changing according to your choice.
 Fixed an issue with the level selection option in the main menu where it remained visible while navigating between other menus.
 Fixed minor placement errors of some level fragments that prevented some placement options.
 Made some small changes to the placement of objects.

notes.title: Update 1.6.5
notes.notes:
Several bugs have been fixed, and a new function has been added, which I believe will be nice. There shouldn't be as many frequent updates from now on; any future updates will likely be for bug fixes that I either detect or you report. Thank you to everyone enjoying my game ^,^


 Added an option to the main menu to select the level you want to play. This option is only accessible once you have completed the game.
 Fixed the cinematic for the fear of the depths where some main models were missing.
 Fixed the cinematics of the endings of Intermediate Level 3 that were not displaying correctly due to misadjusted optimizations.
 Applied some optimizations to the first intermediate level depending on the fear selected.
 Applied some corrections to the initial questionnaire.
 Fixed the animation of the shutter in the main menu when clicking on extras; it now opens and closes correctly.
 Applied outlines to some texts in the end credits for better visibility over white areas.
 Made some difficulty adjustments.



- The demo has also been updated to better represent the final product and to include the optimizations made in the final game to prevent the crashes and issues it initially had. -

notes.title: Update 1.6.2
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.2:


 Modified save system: Now it saves progress upon reaching the target Fragment and after completing the laser puzzle. This way, if there's any issue, you get stuck, or you want to exit the game, you won't have to repeat the entire level again.
 Fixed an issue where sometimes the questionnaire wouldn't allow you to directly enter your name without clicking in the area first.
 Fixed a bug where the flashlight would remain visible during the cinematic of the first intermediate level if the fear of the unknown was selected and the flashlight was active.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes the conversation wouldn't continue after destroying the last wall in the second intermediate level.
 Resolved a graphical issue where reflections were not visible or elements were seen below the ground based on the camera's zenithal position.
 Applied some minor corrections to elements that shouldn't be visible.
 Corrected respawn area placement for falling off certain levels where the position wasn't accurate and didn't apply if you exited a fragment for any reason.
 Adjusted the character model in puzzle levels to be more visible from the top-down view.
 Added a fade-in effect at the start of levels for smoother loading transitions.

notes.title: Update 1.6.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.1:


 Optimization of Intermediate Level 3
 Fixed issues preventing the loading of final cinematics in Intermediate Level 3
 Fixed a bug related to null references that could cause issues or slowdowns with laser puzzles.

notes.title: Update and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to update you on how things are going. After encountering several technical issues, running multiple tests, and gathering feedback from both the demo and internal tests, I realized I needed to focus on optimizing the game as it was consuming graphics resources excessively. After much work, I can say that the final game will be much more optimized than what was seen in the demo, which I'll likely update later to better represent the final game.

I've been working hard on this, which has impacted the planned development schedule a bit. This means I'll be pushing back the release date, but not by much. The good news is that I'll be setting a specific release date. Instead of this April, the final release will be in the following month, specifically on May 10th. With these extra days, I hope to fully polish the experience so you can enjoy this game properly.

It's also true that being my first time publishing a game on Steam, I wasn't fully aware of the review timelines and the extra work needed to configure many things, which has also contributed to this delay. However, it has been a good learning experience to avoid such issues in future projects.

I apologize for the delay, but I believe it's better than releasing a game in poor condition.

I leave you with some new screenshots, and I'll see you soon with the definitive game release.

Thank you for your patience, and I hope you're looking forward to diving into Fragmented World!
